text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps work on both iOS and Android, saving time and money. Responsive design is also essential, as apps must look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps are usually published through app stores like Google Play or the App Store. Performance matters too: users expect fast loading and smooth navigation. Testing regularly helps developers find problems early and improve the user experience before release.
